constraints: Search live. Do not answer from memory. Every rules claim must come from a page you opened in this session. If search/browse is unavailable, return BLOCKED instead of writing from recall.
No invented, reconstructed or half-remembered citations. A source you cannot open is dropped from rules claims and listed only as an unopened lead. Quote verbatim, at most 40 words per quote.

Maximum coverage: exhaust English AND Persian sources. Search transliterations and Persian script: shelem, shalam, shlem, schelem, chelem, shalom card game, shelam card game, شلم, شلیم, بازی شلم, آموزش شلم, قوانین شلم, شلم بازی. Log every query including ones that found nothing.

Preserve disagreements; do not harmonize. Classify every claim as core, documented variant, house/friendly rule, implementation-only mode, regional cognate, or contested/unknown. Mark guesses PARTIAL/BLOCKED.

Mirror the method of the supplied Hokm compendium: source hierarchy with authority notes, per-claim source URLs, terminology table, match-structure section, contested-points section, and a full Q6-style source list with accessed dates and what each source supported.

Breadth minimums: at least 50 sources opened, from at least 25 different domains, with at least 15 Persian-language sources and at least 15 English-language sources. Cover at least 5 of: specialist card-game reference, playable-implementation rules page, app-store description/release notes, Persian-language guide/simulator page, published book, forum/community thread, video transcript, academic or survey text. Any shortfall is delivered as PARTIAL with exact counts reached.
For each source record: link, title, author or site, publication date or 'undated', language, source type, authority note, verbatim quote (max 40 words), and the claims it supports.

Same rigor as the supplied Hokm compendium.

Every source opened (link, title, author/site, date, language, type, authority note, verbatim quote, claims supported) plus every search query run in English and Persian, marking queries that found nothing and leads not opened.

purpose: Establish the complete documented rules universe for Shelem (شلم) with maximum source coverage, as the basis for a later mechanical baseline and engine mirroring the accepted Hokm baseline. Intended use: the single authority file for what Shelem rules are documented, what varies, and what is unknown.

acceptance.condition: Core Shelem (players/partnerships, deck, rank order, deal, bidding/contract, trump/hookm-equivalent if any, trick play, scoring, hand/match win, dealer/turn rotation) is stated claim-by-claim with per-claim source URLs, separating the strongest cross-source consensus from single-source claims.

requirements.requirement: Document the widely supported core rules with per-claim sources.

acceptance.condition: Every player-count form, bidding variant, trump/no-trump mode, scoring variant, and regional/house mode found in the opened sources appears with its mechanics and its sources; implementation-only modes are labeled as such and never substituted for traditional forms.

requirements.requirement: Document all variants and regional/house differences found.

acceptance.condition: Hand scoring, sweep/bonus scoring, match targets, and dealing/turn rotation after each hand are stated with sources; configurable app targets are listed as implementation options, not replacements for the traditional consensus.

requirements.requirement: Document match structures, scoring targets and rotations.

acceptance.condition: Terminology table gives each term, meaning, classification and sources, including Persian-script forms where documented; special situations (bidding, redeals, revokes, bonuses) are sourced or marked unknown.

requirements.requirement: Document terminology, roles and special situations.

acceptance.condition: shelem_evidence.json lists at least 50 opened sources from at least 25 domains (15+ Persian, 15+ English) across at least 5 source types with the required fields, plus the full multilingual query log; any shortfall states exact counts and the response is PARTIAL.

requirements.requirement: Log every source and every search with breadth minimums met or shortfall stated.

in: Live multilingual web research on Shelem rules in English and Persian, all transliterations and Persian script.
Cross-source synthesis with disagreements preserved and authority labeled.
Full query and source logging with verbatim quotes.
out: Strategy advice or new rules proposals.

sources.role: Method and quality template only: source hierarchy, per-claim citations, Q1-Q6 structure, contested-points handling. Not a source of Shelem rules; do not cite it for Shelem claims.

stop_condition: Deliver shelem_rules_compendium.md and shelem_evidence.json; mark gaps PARTIAL/BLOCKED with explicit limitations and counts.
